thinking: glb4b-q8: template default = thinking on (the card's recorded evaluation). comparators: thinking OFF via chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking=false (v2 change: with thinking on and the 20,480-token cap, both comparators spent the whole budget thinking and returned no page in the pre-freeze smoke; see PREREG changelog)

checks.js_error: any uncaught pageerror, or a console message of type error whose text is not 'Failed to load resource' (failed requests are logged separately)

nonempty.bg: median colour of four 16x16 corner patches

checks.glb: magic glTF, version 2, header length == file size, JSON chunk parses, asset.version 2.0, >=1 mesh with >=1 primitive, POSITION accessor count>0, every bufferView inside the BIN chunk, POSITION min/max finite and bounding box extent > 0 on >=2 axes

cdn_note: every http(s) GET the page makes is fetched from the real network once and cached on disk keyed by url; later cells replay the cache (same bytes for every model and seed). nothing is blocked. the page is served from a fake origin http://glb.local/page.html
export_click: first visible element whose text, value, title, aria-label or id matches /export.*glb|glb.*export|download.*glb|save.*glb/i (then, if none, /glb|export|download/i); the download event must fire within export_wait_s
cell_order: seed-major: every prompt of seed 1 for a model, then seed 2; legs run seed pass 1 for the three models (4B, 27B, 35B), then seed pass 2
system_prompt_source: verbatim from the model card system prompt block (https://huggingface.co/ccore/Qwen3.5-4B-GLB-3D-Coder/raw/main/README.md, fetched 2026-11-05); the same string goes to all three models
